storylines: GORD: I said one of two things would happen. Either the scoring opened up, or it stayed at one and we had a bad record. So far it looks like the former. I'll take it. Cautiously. CASEY: That's practically a party from you. Alright — next up: Friday, September twenty-fifth, eight-twenty PM, the Village People stay on the road against the Jager Bombers. No prior history this season, so we don't have a book on them yet, but after tonight? Four goals, a tie in overtime, guys like Stevenson and James getting on the board for the first time this season — I like the momentum heading in. GORD: I like that we know how to score now. I'll need to see it again before I call it momentum. CASEY: That's Ice & Easy. We'll see you Friday.
